description: This file defines the 'Gateway' class for managing Stripe subscription payments within the Omnipay payment processing framework. It extends the AbstractGateway class and provides methods for creating subscription requests and completing purchases.

classes.name: Gateway
classes.description: Handles Stripe subscription payments, providing methods to initiate and complete subscription purchase requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Gateway instance, optionally accepting an HTTP client and HTTP request object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this gateway implementation.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Creates a new subscription request with the given options.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes a purchase process based on provided options and returns a response interface.
